tool.name: CARP
tool.description: Comprehensive Annotation of Repeats Pipeline for plant genomes
tool.command:
## Ensure the baked-in conda tools and pipeline scripts are on PATH even ## if Galaxy execs the container with a cleaned environment. export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/opt/pipeline/scripts:\$PATH &&
## Symlink inputs to .fasta names in the (bind-mounted) job dir so the ## pipeline and RepeatMasker see a real FASTA extension. ln -s '$genome' input_genome.fasta && #if $custom_library ln -s '$custom_library' custom_library.fasta && #end if #if $tandem_repeat_library ln -s '$tandem_repeat_library' tandem_repeat_library.fasta && #end if
mkdir -p output &&
## Build config.yaml printf '%s\n' "genome_fasta: input_genome.fasta" "output_dir: output" > config.yaml && #if $custom_library echo "custom_library: custom_library.fasta" >> config.yaml && #end if #if $tandem_repeat_library echo "tandem_repeat_library: tandem_repeat_library.fasta" >> config.yaml && #end if echo "repeatmasker_sensitivity: $advanced.repeatmasker_sensitivity" >> config.yaml && echo "repeatmasker_culling_limit: $advanced.repeatmasker_culling_limit" >> config.yaml && echo "tidecluster_reannotate_culling_limit: $advanced.tidecluster_reannotate_culling_limit" >> config.yaml &&
## Run the pipeline (Snakemake wrapper, threads from Galaxy) /opt/pipeline/run_pipeline.py -c config.yaml -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} &&
## Unified annotation cp output/Repeat_Annotation_Unified.gff3 '$unified_gff' &&
## Main HTML report + its complete linked tree. repeat_annotation_report.html ## deep-links run_provenance.json, plotly.min.js, DANTE_LTR/, DANTE_TIR/report.html ## and TideCluster/default/ (with its report subtree), so the whole output tree ## must be served alongside it. Exclude only the bulky, non-deep-linked BigWig ## and BAM data (kept in the results archive). cp output/repeat_annotation_report.html '$report' && mkdir -p '$report.extra_files_path' && ( cd output && tar cf - --exclude='*.bw' --exclude='*.bam' --exclude='*bigwig*' . ) | ( cd '$report.extra_files_path' && tar xf - ) &&
## Complete results archive (everything). Built with python's zipfile ## via shutil, because the CARP container image ships no `zip` binary. python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.make_archive('carp_output', 'zip', 'output')" && mv carp_output.zip '$output_archive'

param.name: genome
param.label: Genome assembly (FASTA)
param.help: Plant genome assembly to annotate. Do not use on animal genomes.

param.name: custom_library
param.label: Custom repeat library (optional)
param.help: Extra RepeatMasker-format library. FASTA headers as name#class/subclass, e.g. myCopia_1#Class_I/LTR/Ty1_copia/Ale

param.name: tandem_repeat_library
param.label: Tandem repeat library (optional)
param.help: Reference tandem-repeat library used by TideCluster to name families, e.g. PisTR-B#Satellite

section.name: advanced
section.title: Advanced settings: RepeatMasker speed vs. sensitivity

param.name: repeatmasker_sensitivity
param.label: RepeatMasker sensitivity
param.help: Affects ONLY the similarity-based RepeatMasker masking — the structure-based annotations (DANTE, DANTE_LTR, DANTE_TIR, TideCluster) are not affected. The default 'rush', together with culling below, makes RepeatMasker about 7.5x faster at a small sensitivity cost (roughly 1.8% fewer masked bp). This is the recommended default and is especially suitable for large genomes, where RepeatMasker dominates run time. Choose 'default' or 'quick' for maximum sensitivity when run time is not a concern.

param.name: repeatmasker_culling_limit
param.label: RepeatMasker culling limit (main search)
param.help: rmblastn -culling_limit for the main RepeatMasker step. The default 2 (culling ON) is about 3x faster at only ~0.7% fewer masked bp, by collapsing redundant per-locus hits from the de-novo library; set 0 to turn culling off for maximum sensitivity. Affects only RepeatMasker masking, not the structure-based annotations.

param.name: tidecluster_reannotate_culling_limit
param.label: RepeatMasker culling limit (TideCluster reannotation search)
param.help: Same culling for TideCluster's internal RepeatMasker, independent of the main search. The default 2 is about 3.7x faster at ~0.8% fewer masked bp; set 0 to turn it off.

tool.help:
**What it does**
The Comprehensive Annotation of Repeats Pipeline (CARP) identifies and classifies the repetitive elements of a **plant** genome assembly and merges them into a single, non-overlapping annotation. It integrates:
- **DANTE / DANTE_LTR** — intact LTR retrotransposons - **DANTE_TIR** — TIR DNA transposons - **DANTE_LINE** — LINE elements (experimental) - **TideCluster** — tandem repeats / satellites and rDNA arrays - **RepeatMasker** — genome-wide similarity masking with a CARP-built library
.. class:: warningmark
CARP was developed for plant genomes. Do not use it on animal genomes.
**Inputs**
- *Genome assembly (FASTA)* — the assembly to annotate (required). - *Custom repeat library* — optional extra RepeatMasker-format library (headers ``name#class/subclass``). - *Tandem repeat library* — optional reference library for naming tandem families in TideCluster.
**Advanced settings: RepeatMasker speed vs. sensitivity**
These knobs affect only the similarity-based RepeatMasker masking — the structure-based annotations (DANTE, DANTE_LTR, DANTE_TIR, TideCluster) are **not** affected. The defaults (``rush`` sensitivity with culling limit 2 in both searches) are the recommended, much faster choice, especially suitable for large genomes where RepeatMasker dominates run time; the sensitivity cost is small:
- *Sensitivity* — the default ``rush`` together with culling is about **7.5x faster** than ``default`` at only ~1.8 % fewer masked bp. Use ``default`` or ``quick`` for maximum sensitivity when run time is not a concern. - *Culling limit (main search)* — default ``2`` (on) is about **3x faster** at ~0.7 % fewer masked bp; ``0`` turns culling off. - *Culling limit (TideCluster reannotation search)* — default ``2`` is about **3.7x faster** at ~0.8 % fewer masked bp; ``0`` turns it off.
**Outputs**
- *Complete results archive* (zip) — the full ``output/`` directory, including per-class GFF3 files, density BigWig tracks, summary statistics and plots. - *Unified repeat annotation* (GFF3) — ``Repeat_Annotation_Unified.gff3``, the authoritative non-overlapping annotation. - *Repeat annotation report* (HTML) — the main ``repeat_annotation_report.html`` with its complete linked tree: the DANTE_LTR, DANTE_TIR and TideCluster sub-reports and the run provenance are browsable from it. (The bulky BigWig and BAM tracks are not embedded in the report — get those from the archive.)
**Container**
The tool runs from the CARP Singularity/Apptainer image published to GHCR (``oras://ghcr.io/kavonrtep/carp/sif:@CONTAINER_TAG@``). The Galaxy instance must have Singularity/Apptainer enabled and able to pull ``oras://`` images.
More information: https://github.com/kavonrtep/CARP
